title: SYSK Selects: Who killed JFK?
summary: SYSK Selects rerun of the 2013 episode "Who Killed JFK," chosen by Josh as a classic. The hosts skim the JFK assassination: the motive behind the Dallas trip, the motorcade and shooting at Dealey Plaza, the "magic bullet" path, the Grassy Knoll and acoustics debate, the Texas School Book Depository sniper's nest, Oswald's background (Marines, Russia, Walker shooting, New Orleans, Cuba), Oswald's killing by Jack Ruby, the Warren Commission, the 1970s House Select Committee on Assassinations, the Rockefeller Commission, and conspiracy theories (mob, CIA, KGB/Cuba, three tramps, Woody Harrelson's father). The episode ends with listener mail from a Wuhan English teacher about using the zombie episode for a lesson.
topics: Lyndon Johnson swearing in Air Force One

segments.title: Selects intro and episode setup
segments.summary: Josh introduces the SYSK Selects pick, the 2013 episode Who Killed JFK, and the hosts discuss how enduring the JFK assassination conspiracy theories are, noting they will only skim the topic.

segments.title: Dallas trip and the shooting
segments.summary: The hosts explain why Kennedy went to Dallas (reuniting feuding Texas Democrats Connally and Yarborough ahead of reelection), the published motorcade route, and the shooting at Dealey Plaza around 12:30 p.m., including the head shot and Jackie's reaction.

segments.title: Magic bullet and the Grassy Knoll
segments.summary: The hosts describe the path of the bullet that hit Kennedy's neck and then Governor Connally, which is called the magic bullet, and discuss the acoustics and eyewitness confusion about where the shots came from, including the officer running toward the Grassy Knoll.

segments.title: Kennedy's death and LBJ swearing-in
segments.summary: Kennedy is pronounced dead at Parkland Memorial at about 1 p.m. and Johnson is sworn in as president on Air Force One before it flies back to Washington.

segments.title: Sniper's nest and Tippit killing
segments.summary: Police search the Texas School Book Depository and find a sniper's nest on the sixth floor. Oswald is briefly let go by Truly, then kills Officer J. D. Tippit and is caught in the Texas Theatre.

segments.title: Lee Harvey Oswald's background
segments.summary: The hosts profile Oswald: his childhood with a absent father and orphanage stay, his Marine Corps service and Russian study, his defection attempt to the Soviet Union, return to Texas with Marina, and his attempted shooting of General Edwin Walker.

segments.title: New Orleans, Cuba, and Oswald's motives
segments.summary: Oswald's New Orleans pro-Cuba activity, his failed attempts to get help from Cuban and Soviet embassies in Mexico City, and the hosts' discussion of whether he was a patsy manipulated by others.
topics: Oswald New Orleans Fair Play for Cuba

segments.title: Warren Commission and Jack Ruby
segments.summary: The Warren Commission concludes Oswald acted alone, and the hosts discuss the Warren Report, the finance check, and Jack Ruby's killing of Oswald two days after the assassination, including the mob connection theory.

segments.title: Conspiracy theories: CIA, House committee, Rockefeller, three tramps
segments.summary: The hosts cover CIA and LBJ inside-job theories, the 1970s House Select Committee finding a probable conspiracy, the Rockefeller Commission, the three tramps theory and the Woody Harrelson father rumor, and George Joannides' CIA ties.

segments.title: Closing and sign-off
segments.summary: The hosts wrap up that the debate will not end, mention the stuff they don't want you to know podcast and HowStuffWorks article, and sign off.

segments.title: Listener mail: Chinese zombies
segments.summary: Sam LaRussa, an English teacher in Wuhan, China, writes that he used the how zombies work episode to save a lesson after oversleeping.
